"The chart displays month-over-month (m/m) inflation data from February 2022 to April 2024.

### **Chart Overview**
- **Title:** Inflation Components
- **Y-Axis:** Percent (m/m), ranging from 0 to 30.
- **X-Axis:** Monthly timeline from Feb-22 to Apr-24.
- **Series:** 
    - **Headline Inflation** (Dark blue line)
    - **Core Inflation** (Light blue line)

### **Data Observations**
The following table provides approximate monthly values based on the chart's visual representation:

| Month | Headline (%) | Core (%) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Feb-22 | 3.9 | 4.0 |
| Mar-22 | 6.7 | 6.5 |
| Apr-22 | 6.0 | 6.7 |
| May-22 | 5.1 | 5.1 |
| Jun-22 | 5.3 | 5.1 |
| Jul-22 | 7.4 | 7.3 |
| Aug-22 | 7.0 | 6.8 |
| Sep-22 | 6.2 | 5.5 |
| Oct-22 | 6.3 | 5.5 |
| Nov-22 | 4.9 | 4.8 |
| Dec-22 | 5.1 | 5.3 |
| Jan-23 | 6.0 | 5.4 |
| Feb-23 | 6.6 | 7.7 |
| Mar-23 | 7.7 | 7.2 |
| Apr-23 | 8.4 | 8.4 |
| May-23 | 7.8 | 7.9 |
| Jun-23 | 6.0 | 6.5 |
| Jul-23 | 6.3 | 6.5 |
| Aug-23 | 12.4 | 13.8 |
| Sep-23 | 12.7 | 13.4 |
| Oct-23 | 8.3 | 8.5 |
| Nov-23 | 12.8 | 13.0 |
| **Dec-23 (Peak)** | **25.5** | **28.3** |
| Jan-24 | 20.6 | 20.2 |
| Feb-24 | 13.2 | 12.3 |
| Mar-24 | 11.0 | 9.4 |
| Apr-24 | 8.8 | 6.3 |

### **Summary of Trends**
*   **Stability Phase (Feb-22 to Jul-23):** Inflation fluctuated between roughly 4% and 8%.
*   **Initial Surge (Aug-23):** Both components doubled, jumping above 12%.
*   **Major Peak (Dec-23):** Inflation spiked sharply to its highest levels in the period shown, with Core inflation notably exceeding Headline inflation.
*   **Sharp Decrease (Jan-24 to Apr-24):** Both figures have declined rapidly following the December peak, with Core inflation falling faster than Headline inflation in the final months."
